WebCivil Supreme is provided as a FREE public service by the New York State Unified Court System. Website Terms of Use This system and all data are the property of the New York State Unified Court System (UCS). This site may not be directly linked to by any website without the express written permission of UCS. Unauthorized use or attempted unauthorized use of this system may subject you to appropriate disciplinary action and criminal or civil pena
